# meshmsg v0.1.17

This release adds attachment sharing from the mobile web UI.

## Web attachment sharing

- Adds a browser file picker and uploads one selected regular file at a time through the loopback web bridge.
- Streams uploads into owner-only, size-bounded staging paths and submits them through the daemon's existing verified attachment share operation.
- Uses canonical daemon events for outgoing attachment cards, avoiding optimistic duplicates across browser tabs.
- Validates portable filenames, configured attachment limits, capability support, and versioned daemon completion metadata.
- Preserves the selected file when the outcome is rejected or unknown, never retries automatically, and warns when retrying could publish a duplicate offer.
- Bounds concurrent uploads and operation lifetimes, removes staging after definite outcomes, and safely ages out files retained after ambiguous daemon replies.
- Expands DOM, fake-daemon, and real-peer integration coverage for uploads, failure semantics, cleanup, and end-to-end receipt/download.

Files shared from the web UI use the existing topic-wide plaintext attachment capability model; they are not private-message attachments. Restart running daemons after installation so the web process can negotiate attachment sharing.

Install this exact source release:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.17 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.16...v0.1.17
